exact.拖拽旋转、中键平移、滚轮缩放，看真实高程堆出来的中国：青藏高原隆起、四大盆地凹陷: Drag to rotate, middle-drag to pan, scroll to zoom, and watch China rise from real elevation data: the Tibetan Plateau bulging, the four great basins sinking, the coastline winding. exact.：地形高程取自本地 WGS84 经纬度 DEM（约 370 米/像元，覆盖中国陆: : Terrain elevation comes from a local WGS84 lat/lon DEM (~370 m per pixel, covering mainland China, Taiwan Island and Hainan Island). The national outline follows public administrative boundary data; peak and basin coordinates are compiled from public geographic references and their labelled elevations sampled from the DEM. For popular-science browsing only — not for delimitation.
